aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the mask tolerance comparison but overgroups line/date contexts and includes unsupported measurement-style outcomes.
issues: Changed factor mixes mask tolerance with GMI/DT line labels instead of preserving line/date as subgroups.
DT ±3db row is omitted from changed factor and outcome grouping.
Sheet1 and Test results appear duplicated but are treated as separate outcome domains.
Measurement outcome is derived from a header/category row and is not valid measurement evidence.
Title/file side mismatch L vs R needs context check if side matters.
requiredUserQuestions: Should GMI and DT line/date results be separate subgroups under one mask tolerance comparison?
correctionPlan: Set primary factor to Normal mask ±4db vs test mask ±2db and ±3db.
Add subgroup keys for date, line, and side if supported by rows.
Include complete rows for each subgroup, including DT ±3db.
Merge duplicate function defect tables or mark one as supporting evidence only.
Remove or recast the measurement outcome as defect category breakdown only if data rows support it.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are not sufficient: key subgroup rows are missing and one cited row is only a header.
